D: A hotshot pilot battles his past and a very bad mission.
P: Serve the mains during the bacon and eggs scene on Ramada's stomach.
S: Brioche rounds topped with fried quail eggs, crisp bacon and chives
Quail eggs fried in butter on small toasted brioche rounds with a sliver of crisp bacon and chives.
Airbase soft pretzels with beer cheese

Warm soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, served with a hot, smooth cheddar and lager dip and a pot of grainy mustard. Brush 4 large soft pretzels with 30g melted butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 200ml lager and 100ml milk until thick. Off the heat, stir in 200g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon and a pinch of cayenne until smooth. Serve the pretzels with the cheese dip and wholegrain mustard.
Twice-fried thick chips served with homemade garlic aioli
Thick-cut chips blanched at 140C, fried at 185C, salted, with aioli (garlic, yolk, lemon and oil whisked) for dipping.
M: Airbase rib eye, corn and slaw
Grilled rib eyes and corn on the cob with creamy cabbage slaw
Rib eye steaks grilled hot, corn on the cob, coleslaw with a creamy vinegar dressing.
Sizzling hot plate bacon and egg rolls
the famous hot stomach, we used a pan

Thick bacon rendered crisp and eggs fried in the fat with runny yolks, stacked in toasted milk buns with cheddar, rocket and smoky barbecue sauce. Fry 8 thick bacon rashers over medium heat for 8 minutes until crisp, then keep warm. Fry 4 eggs in the bacon fat, basting the whites with hot fat until set but leaving the yolks runny. Split and toast 4 milk buns. Lay a slice of cheddar on each bottom bun so it softens, then add rocket, 2 rashers of bacon, an egg and a spoon of barbecue sauce.
W: Baked egg custard tarts in sweet shortcrust, nutmeg on top
Sweet shortcrust cases blind-baked, filled with vanilla custard (milk, cream, eggs, sugar), baked at 150C until just set, nutmeg on top.
K: Vodka, lime and spicy ginger beer in a chilled mug

Vodka and fresh lime over ice, topped with spicy ginger beer in chilled copper or steel mugs, with a mint sprig and lime wheel. Chill 4 copper or steel mugs in the freezer for 15 minutes, then fill with ice. Add 45ml vodka and 15ml fresh lime juice to each mug. Top each with 150ml cold, spicy ginger beer and stir once from the bottom. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a sprig of mint slapped between your palms to release the oils.

dishes.make_ahead: Toast the brioche rounds up to 1 day ahead, airtight; fry the bacon and quail eggs just before serving

steps.text: Cut 12 small rounds from the brioche and toast them.
Fry the bacon until crisp and break into pieces.
Fry the quail eggs in butter.
Put an egg and a bit of bacon on each round and sprinkle with chives.

veg.make_ahead: Toast the brioche rounds up to 1 day ahead, airtight; fry the mushrooms and quail eggs just before serving

steps.text: Cut 12 small rounds from the brioche and toast them.
Fry the mushrooms in half the butter with the soy and smoked paprika until crisp.
Fry the quail eggs in the rest of the butter.
Put an egg and a few crisp mushrooms on each round and sprinkle with chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Fry the chips the first time up to 4 hours ahead and rest them; make the aioli up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; fry again just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips.
Fry in 140C oil, then rest.
Whisk the yolk, crushed garlic and lemon juice, then drip in the oil until thick.
Fry again at 185C until crisp.
Salt the chips and serve with the aioli.

dishes.n: Airbase rib eye, corn and slaw
dishes.make_ahead: Make the slaw up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; grill the steaks and corn on the night

steps.text: Shred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Grill the steaks and corn over high heat.
Rest the steaks and serve with corn and slaw.

veg.n: Airbase cauliflower steak, corn and slaw
veg.make_ahead: Make the slaw up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; cut and grill the cauliflower steaks and corn on the night

steps.text: Shred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower and brush with the olive oil, smoked paprika and salt.
Grill the cauliflower steaks and corn over medium high heat, turning, until charred and tender.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with corn and slaw.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bring to room temperature to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 12-hole muffin tray with rounds of pastry.
Blind-bake the cases.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream and sugar.
Fill the cases and grate nutmeg on top.
Bake at 150C until just set.
Cool before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the mugs and juice the lime up to 1 day ahead; build over ice with the vodka and ginger beer to serve

steps.text: Chill the mugs in the freezer, then fill with ice.
Add vodka and lime juice to each mug.
Top with ginger beer and stir once from the bottom.
Garnish with a lime wheel and a slapped mint sprig.

af.make_ahead: Muddle the ginger with the lime juice up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; build over ice and top with ginger beer to serve

steps.text: Chill the mugs in the freezer, then fill with ice.
Muddle a few slices of ginger with the lime juice and divide between the mugs.
Top with ginger beer and stir once from the bottom.
Garnish with a lime wheel and a slapped mint sprig.

s.note: Brioche rounds topped with fried quail eggs, crisp bacon and chives
s.how: Toast 12 small rounds of brioche. Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and break into pieces. Fry 12 quail eggs in 30g butter for a minute. Put an egg and a bit of bacon on each round and sprinkle with chives.

s.note: Twice-fried thick chips served with homemade garlic aioli
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 185C until crisp. Whisk 1 yolk, 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice, then drip in 200ml oil until thick. Salt the chips and serve with the aioli.

m.n: Airbase rib eye, corn and slaw
m.note: Grilled rib eyes and corn on the cob with creamy cabbage slaw
m.how: Grill 4 rib eyes and 4 corn cobs over high heat. Shred a quarter cabbage and 2 carrots and toss with 100g mayo, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt. Rest the steaks 5 minutes and serve with the corn and slaw.

w.note: Baked egg custard tarts in sweet shortcrust, nutmeg on top
w.how: Line a 12-hole muffin tray with rounds cut from 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and blind-bake. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml milk, 125ml cream and 80g sugar. Fill the cases, grate nutmeg on top and bake at 150C for 20 minutes until just set.

d.note: Vodka, lime and spicy ginger beer in a chilled mug
d.how: Chill 4 copper or steel mugs in the freezer for 15 minutes, then fill with ice. Add 45ml vodka and 15ml fresh lime juice to each mug. Top each with 150ml cold, spicy ginger beer and stir once from the bottom. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a sprig of mint slapped between your palms to release the oils.
